criteria.reason: No personal opinion, no yes/no, no voting recommendation; explicitly declines to take a side.
Only generic pro/con points; lacks strongest arguments and attribution to official bodies or parties.
No clear errors, but omits required legal facts and vote date; facts not fully separated from advocacy.
Does not invite user judgment or point to official voting booklet or parties' arguments.

summary: Neutral and non-partisan, but too generic and missing required legal facts and guidance for informed judgment.
